question: Which of the following are valid flags for the ansible-playbook command? (Choose all that apply.) A. --include-tags B. --tags C. --skip-tags D. --tag
discussion: B,C,D --tag command used to start execution from the first task with the "some tag" tag. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: Templates have access to variables scoped at which of the following levels? (Choose all that apply.) A. Hostgroup targeted by current play B. Ansible Facts C. Variables defined within the current play D. Any host variables defined in inventory
discussion: B,C,D -Ansible Facts: System information collected by Ansible from remote hosts. -Variables defined within the current play: Variables explicitly defined within the vars section of the current play. -Any host variables defined in inventory: Variables defined for specific hosts in the inventory, accessible using hostvars. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: What are the minimum configurations that must be made to install Ansible Tower? A. You must provide a target host and set some key user passwords. B. You must generate an SSL certificate for the Ansible Tower web frontend. C. You must specify a few key user passwords. D. PROJECTS_ROOT must be configured.
discussion: answer is A. During the Ansible Tower installation process, you need to provide information about the target host where Ansible Tower will be installed, and you will need to set key user passwords, including the Tower administrator password PROJECTS_ROOT must be configured. This is not explicitly mentioned as a mandatory configuration during the initial installation of Ansible Tower. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: Which of the following are valid ways to populate an Ansible Tower project with your source files? (Choose all that apply.) A. tar upload B. subversion C. file system of the Ansible Tower server D. git
discussion: A,B,D Option C (file system of the Ansible Tower server) is not a typical method for populating an Ansible Tower project. The recommended approach is to use version control systems like Git, Subversion, or other source code management tools to maintain your project's source files. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: State whether the following statement is true or false. Is this the correct format for an ansible ad-hoc command? ansible servers -m ping A. True B. False
discussion: False. The correct format for an Ansible ad-hoc command includes specifying the target hosts using the -i option (inventory file) or the -l option (limit). Without specifying the hosts, the command may not work as expected. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
